page_data.en:
Communist propaganda called "Labourers
and Peasants Bulletin" No 1 , date 14/3/33
sent to Reuters' News agency .

1. Statement by General Li Ming saying he
& other generals & officers had joined
the Soviet Government . The statement
was signed by the following :
Li Ming , Commander of 52nd Division
Chen Shi Chi . " " 19th "
Chow Tz Oak . Brigade Commander , 5th Division
Pang Mong King , Regimental " , 59th "
Li Chung Tung , Chief of Staff , 52nd "
Chen Hung Chen , Staff Officer , 59th "
Chow Kuo Hwa , " " 52nd "
Ho Sik Jen , Labour Battalion Comdr , 52nd "
( These Generals & officers were captured
by the Red Army at Hee Hwang 宜黃 &
Loh An 樂安 during February-March 1933. )

2 Madame Sun Yat-sen's statement re arrest-
Handing over by the Municipal Police to
the Chinese authorities of five prisoners
named Loo Long Yui , Yu Wen Hwo ,
Hsiao Chen Chih ( son of late Chiang Kai )
Tehin Kwang & Chen I Ling .
page_data.zh:
题为《工农公报》第1号的共产主义宣传品，日期为1933年3月14日，已发送至路透社新闻社。

1. 李明将军的声明，称他与其他将军及军官已加入苏维埃政府。该声明由以下人员签署：
李明，第52师师长
陈士杰（音译），第19师师长
周子尧（音译），第5旅旅长
庞孟卿（音译），第59团团长
李仲东（音译），第52师参谋长
陈洪臣（音译），第59师参谋
周国华（音译），第52师参谋
何式仁（音译），第52师劳工营营长
（这些将军和军官于1933年2月至3月期间，在宜黄及乐安被红军俘虏。）

2. 孙逸仙夫人关于逮捕事件的声明——
公共租界警务处将五名囚犯移交给中国当局，这五人名为：陆龙瑞（音译）、余文火（音译）、萧陈志（已故蒋介之子）（原文如此）、德钦光（音译）及陈一玲（音译）。

2.
Statement issued by the Chinese Communist
Party declaring that the Kuomintang Party
has been fabricating certain rumours regarding
the Red Army, etc. & giving statistics
of arms seized when Government troops
were defeated in Kiangsi.
page_data.zh:
2.
中国共产党发表的声明，宣称国民党正在捏造有关红军等的谣言，并提供了政府军在江西战败时被缴获的武器统计数据。

page_data.en:
FARMERS AND LABOUR NEWS AGENCY
BULLETIN No. 1

A.
IT SAYS THAT GENERAL LI MIN, COMMANDER OF THE 52ND
DIVISION, WHO WAS REPORTED TO HAVE COMMITTED SUICIDE
ON THE KIANGSI FRONT, IS STILL ALIVE AND HAS FORMALLY
JOINED THE COMMUNIST "CHINESE SOVIET GOVERNMENT". ASIDE
FROM GENERAL LI, ANOTHER DIVISIONAL COMMANDER AND ALL OTHER
OFFICERS OF LOWER RANKS AND THE SOLDIERS CAPTURED BY THE
RED ARMY, HAVE ALL SURRENDERED. IT ALSO GIVES THE TEXT OF
A JOINT STATEMENT ISSUED BY GENERAL LI AND OTHERS ANNOUNCING
THEIR FORMAL DECISION TO JOIN THE "SOVIET GOVERNMENT."

B.
A STATEMENT OF MADAME SUN YAT-SEN IN WHICH SHE STRONGLY
ATTACKED THE NATIONAL GOVERNMENT for IMPRISONING THE LEADERS of the
"ANTI-IMPERIALIST MOVEMENT". SHE SAID THAT THE FIVE PERSONS
RECENTLY ARRESTED BY THE INTERNATIONAL SETTLEMENT POLICE
DID NOTHING WRONG, THEY WERE ARRESTED BECAUSE THE IMPERIALI-
STS ARE AFRAID OF THEM AND THAT there was AN UNDERSTANDING BETWEEN
THE KUOMINTANG AND THE IMPERIALISTS TO CRUSH ALL THE ANTI-
MOVEMENTS
IMPERIALISTS IN CHINA. SHE GOES ON TO ATTACK THE EXISTENCE
OF FOREIGN SETTLEMENT IN SHANGHAI, REGARDING IT AS THE BASE
OF THE WHITE IMPERIALISTS IN THEIR AGGRESSION ON CHINA.

From me
page_data.zh:
农民与劳工新闻社
公报 第1号

A.
据称，原报道在江西前线自杀的第52师师长李明将军仍然在世，并已正式加入共产主义“中华苏维埃政府”。除李将军外，另一位师长以及被红军俘获的所有其他低级军官和士兵均已投降。文中还刊登了李将军等人发布的联合声明全文，宣布他们正式决定加入“苏维埃政府”。

B.
孙逸仙夫人的声明，她在声明中强烈抨击国民政府监禁“反帝运动”领导人。她说，近期被国际租界警察逮捕的五人并无过错，他们被捕是因为帝国主义者害怕他们，并且国民党与帝国主义者之间达成默契，要镇压中国所有的反帝运动。她接着抨击上海外国租界的存 在，视其为白色帝国主义者侵略中国的基地。

来自我

page_data.en:
C.
A STATEMENT OF THE CENTRAL EXECUTIVE COMMITTEE OF THE
COMMUNIST PARTY IN SHANGHAI. IN THIS STATEMENT THE COMMU-
NISTS DECLARED THAT GENERAL CHIANG KAI-SHEK HAD SENT HIS
PERSONAL REPRESENTATIVE TO NEGOTIATE WITH THE JAPANESE
IMPERIALISTS . GENERAL CHIANG HAS PROMISED TO GIVE UP JEHOL
AND THE MANCHURIAN PROVINCES IN RETURN FOR JAPANESE SUPPORT
IN THE COMMUNIST SUPPRESSION MOVEMENT.

IT GOES ON TO SAY THAT THE ARMS AND AMMUNITION OF THE
RED ARMY WERE **〔此处转录不清〕** "SUPPLIED" BY THE GOVERNMENT FORCES. IT
DECLARES THAT IN 1932 THE RED ARMY CAPTURED THE FOLLOWING
ARMS FROM THE GOVERNMENT FORCES IN KIANGSI:-

91,280      RIFLES
34          FIELD GUNS
135         TRENCH MORTARS
1,090       MACHINE GUNS
13          RADIO SETS
6           AEROPLANES.

DURING THE PERIOD BETWEEN JANUARY 1, 1933 TO FEBRUARY
15TH, THE COMMUNIST ARMY **〔此处转录不清〕** CAPTURED THE FOLLOWING ARMS
FROM THE GOVERNMENT FORCES:-

12,363      RIFLES
5           FIELD GUNS
2           TRENCH MORTARS
1           WIRELESS SET
page_data.zh:
C.
中国共产党上海中央执行委员会的声明。在该声明中，共产党人宣称蒋介石已派遣其私人代表与日本帝国主义者进行谈判。蒋介石承诺放弃热河及东北各省，以换取日本在剿共运动中的支持。

声明继续称，红军的武器弹药是由政府军“供应”的。**〔此处转录不清〕** 它宣称，1932年红军在江西从政府军手中缴获了以下武器：

91,280      支步枪
34          门野战炮
135         门战壕迫击炮
1,090       挺机枪
13          部无线电收发报机
6           架飞机。

在1933年1月1日至2月15日期间，共产党军队从政府军手中缴获了以下武器：**〔此处转录不清〕**

12,363      支步枪
5           门野战炮
2           门战壕迫击炮
1           部无线电台
